scientific.integrity: The source line and conic were parametrized exactly; an explicit quartic equation was checked on the Hadamard parametrization; both Jacobian-ideal containments were certified by polynomial identities and exact Groebner reduction; the twisted-cubic identification was checked by rank four of the binary-cubic coordinate system.
scientific.limitations: The result identifies only the reduced singular locus. It does not classify the nonreduced Jacobian scheme, special local analytic points on the double curve, or the normalization of the quartic.

title: The sharp line–conic Hadamard quartic has a twisted-cubic singular locus
